title: SoftForge Electronic Workbench
description: Schematic and PCB design workbench for VS Code that reads and writes KiCad files, with live ERC/DRC, interactive routing, 3D, fabrication outputs and an agent CLI.

title: SoftForge OCCT add-on
description: STEP import and export, outlines from STEP and DXF, 2D booleans and enclosure bosses for the SoftForge Electronic Workbench extension, powered by opencascade.js (OpenCASCADE compiled to WebAssembly).

title: SoftForge Router Pro
description: The paid autorouter of SoftForge Electronic Workbench: differential pairs, length matching per group and net class, blind / buried and micro vias, area and incremental routing, several strategies on several cores. 14-day trial.

title: CRBasic (opencrbasic)
description: CRBasic language support for CR6 programs, backed by the opencrbasic language server.

title: PlanSignal
description: Review saved Terraform plans for destructive changes and security risks. Never runs terraform apply.

title: PeopleSoft SQR
description: Syntax highlighting, linting, snippets, hover documentation and navigation for the PeopleSoft SQR language (.sqr / .sqc).

title: rmvbg – Remove Background
description: rmvbg — Cut out. Capture. Record. Remove image backgrounds locally, free.

title: Lockpin
description: See what every AI agent spends as it works, catch the runaway ones when Lockpin flags a spike, a loop or drift off goal, and cap each task before the call. Rates your prompts for cost as you write them. Needs the local Lockpin proxy; your keys never leave your machine.

title: Salesforce Org Parity – Config Diff for QA
description: Compare the configuration of two Salesforce orgs (sandbox vs production) with a QA lens: permissions & FLS, validation rules, flows, custom settings/metadata values and more. 100% local, uses your Salesforce CLI login, no telemetry.

title: sqlc-plus
description: Convert sqlc queries into executable parameterized SQL, copied to clipboard

title: MiniMindsLab: Dedupe Selected Lines
description: Remove duplicate selected lines while preserving the first occurrence order.
